about.label: What the company does
about.text: Makes resins and gel coats for composite materials. Customers use the materials in vehicles, construction, boats and energy equipment.

about.label: Owner
about.text: Part of the Polynt Group, based in Italy. Black Diamond Capital Management has controlled the group since 2021.

about.label: Jacksonville plant
about.text: Makes chemicals for coatings and composite resins. The source is a company quality certificate that expired on 2024-10-01.

about.label: Orlando plant
about.text: Makes gel coats. The source is the same certificate, which has expired.

news.headline: Hiring a Maintenance Manager in Jacksonville. The posting asks for vibration analysis, thermal imaging and oil analysis, and names downtime as a goal.
news.action: Contact the Jacksonville Site Manager. The posting says the Maintenance Manager reports to that person.
news.caution: A posting date can be a repost date. Check that the role is still open.

news.headline: Hiring a maintenance mechanic in Jacksonville for pumps, valves, piping, agitators, fans and seals.
news.action: Ask which of these machines cause the most unplanned work.
news.caution: A posting does not prove that the role is still open.

news.headline: Hiring an Engineering Manager in Jacksonville to manage plant reliability and the process safety program.
news.action: Treat plant engineering as a second contact path.
news.caution: A posting does not prove that the role is still open.

news.headline: Polynt closed its Pensacola plant. A local report says the plant stopped operating in September.
news.action: Do not target Pensacola. Confirm the job of any Pensacola contact.
